description: Header file defining inline functions for gradient clipping utilities in PyTorch's C++ API, including functions to clip gradient norms and values for tensors and parameter collections.

methods.name: clip_grad_norm_
methods.description: Clips the gradient norm of a vector of tensors, with options for different norm types and error handling.

methods.name: clip_grad_norm_ (initializer_list)
methods.description: Wrapper to call clip_grad_norm_ with a braced-init-list of tensors.

methods.name: clip_grad_norm_ (single tensor)
methods.description: Wrapper to call clip_grad_norm_ with a single tensor.

methods.name: clip_grad_value_
methods.description: Clips the gradient values of a collection of tensors in-place.

methods.name: clip_grad_value_ (initializer_list)
methods.description: Wrapper to call clip_grad_value_ with a braced-init-list of tensors.

methods.name: clip_grad_value_ (single tensor)
methods.description: Wrapper to call clip_grad_value_ with a single tensor.
